Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

reply.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for staying in touch with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We always value our business relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and are keen to keep supporting your production with our wide range of quality steel products and dedicated service.

Regarding the current discussions, our current Angebot stands at a price of €6.10 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Without movement from your side we cannot move either. We hope you understand our position, and we remain available should you wish to discuss how we can move forward together.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
